model_config.host_context: Three instrumented CPU proofs at sequential indices 0/1/2 from one fresh P8 commitment; no secret copies or restores. Every proof independently verifies with expected-model pin and wrong-model rejection. Apple M4 Max 48 GiB, 16 Rayon threads; each measured command starts below one-minute load 3. Load and memory/swap observations retained before and after; quiet starts do not establish an isolated host. BSD time -l whole-process costs include artifact decode, witness, self-verification and memory management. No CLI seed equality is assumed. T32 calibration below L2a T64, CPU only. Nested stage children are already in their parents; unattributed remainders remain CPU cost. No speedup or ADR-127 GO claim.

model.cqis: int8 matrices, int16 gains (G=8), F=7, A15 groups of 128 on norm-fed inputs and head, direct exp

note: RFC-0026 development tier (RFC-0018 A1): no security level, FS unproven, PCS conjectural. dev-zk profile byte 4 (balanced policy-2 hiding sources, RFC-0013 A8; RFC-0026 A9), development tier; zero knowledge is conditional and computational (seed-derived masks). The weights and the 1-D records (RFC-0013 A7) are committed once by commit-model as one published commitment for P = 8 proofs (A6), recorded as stage model_commitment_once and not part of the prove time. Prover time is the prove-dev --zk process wall time of proof index 1: Artifact decode, executor capture, plain check and proof (witness_recompute_ns 0). Verifier time is verify-dev with --expect-model; another proof against the same commitment also verifies. The control is verify-dev of a proof pinned to another model digest. Repeats, if any, are in model_config.host_context. Soundness ledger (verify-dev, E12-26): eps_interactive <= 731241032/p^4; worst round LU+ZD check 5, 2^-95.4, grinding 0 bits. CPU only, no GPU. Peak RSS is the BSD /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size. Not a cost-model fit input.
